item.title: Bulletin updated at 08:45 HKT 20/Nov/2024
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of the northeast monsoon, it will still be windy with some rain over the coast of Guangdong and the northern part of the South China Sea today. The weather will be cooler. Meanwhile, a broad band of clouds associated with the remnants of Man-yi will cover the region. With the northeast monsoon moderating gradually, it will become brighter over the coast of Guangdong in the latter part of this week. Temperatures during the day will rise slightly. Under the influence of a replenishment of the monsoon, it will be windy over the coast of Guangdong with a few rain patches over the weekend. Another surge of the northeast monsoon is expected to reach southern China midweek next week. Temperatures will fall again over the region.

Weather: Cloudy to overcast with rain. Rain will be heavier at times at first. Slightly cooler. There will be swells.
